$comment: Machine-readable source of truth for tier entitlements. The app, the Stripe configuration and docs/V5_PRODUCT_SPEC.md all read from this file so they cannot drift. Prices are a launch decision, not a benchmarked claim.

billing.$comment: Billing is OFF during launch. The tier matrix below is fully defined so it can be switched on without redesign, but while mode is 'free_launch' every user receives the entitlements of `free_launch_grants` and no Stripe object is required. Flip mode to 'subscriptions' only after the product has proven itself.
billing.free_launch_note: Pro is granted rather than Black: Pro is the tier whose value has to be proven (catalyst intelligence, technical/news alignment, Poly). Black carries API access and export, which have real cost and no demonstration value during a free launch.

stripe_account.requirement: Squeeze Scanner must use its OWN Stripe account, separate from any other business in this org.
stripe_account.do_not_use: acct_1Sr1rAA99FsxroMn — an unrelated business's live account. Squeeze Scanner is its own entity and must never write products, prices or features into it.
stripe_account.verified_finding: The only Stripe account reachable from this session is acct_1Sr1rAA99FsxroMn (live + sandbox). Its live catalog holds four 'Frontline Sales Support' products. No Squeeze Scanner object exists in it and none was created.
stripe_account.why_nothing_is_wired: Two independent blockers: (1) billing.mode is 'free_launch', so there is nothing to charge for yet; (2) the only reachable account belongs to a different business. Creating the new account requires the owner to sign in to Stripe and create it — it cannot be done from here.
stripe_account.first_step: Owner creates a dedicated Squeeze Scanner Stripe account at dashboard.stripe.com, then connects it to this session.
stripe_account.then: Build and verify the catalog in that account's sandbox using the lookup_keys already defined on each tier below, flip billing.mode to 'subscriptions', and only then go live.

license_gated.$comment: Never enabled in any tier until the underlying data is licensed. Shipping these as entitlements before the licence exists would sell something that does not run.

poly_execution.requires: a separate, independently audited execution subsystem
poly_execution.note: No tier grants order submission, key handling or custody. V1 is read-only by architecture, not by configuration.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.principle: Useful but limited — never intentionally stale. A free user must be able to experience why Squeeze Scanner is different, on live data.

tiers.name: Core
tiers.principle: The complete real-time technical engine, with the risk context that makes it usable.
tiers.annual_note: Two months free vs $468/yr monthly. Inert until billing.mode == 'subscriptions'.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.principle: The differentiator tier. Everything in Core plus the catalyst layer — this is where technical-versus-catalyst fusion lives.
tiers.annual_note: Two months free vs $1068/yr monthly. Inert until billing.mode == 'subscriptions'.

tiers.name: Black
tiers.principle: Genuinely different work, not simply more of the same. Portfolio-level exposure, event studies, scenario analysis and programmatic access.
tiers.annual_note: Two months free vs $2388/yr monthly. Inert until billing.mode == 'subscriptions'.

market_brain.lite: market state, next scheduled catalyst, danger-zone summary. No conflicts list, no ranked setups, no per-ticker fusion.
market_brain.full: every field in the MarketBrain schema, including conflicts and ranked setups.
market_brain.personalized: full, plus a brief scoped to the user's own watchlist and positions.

scanner.limited: top N results only, no custom filters, no scan presets.
scanner.full: all ten scans, all columns, saved presets.

live_intelligence.full: catalyst feed with impact / direction / confidence, source tiering, confirmation status, dedup, propagation and per-ticker fusion.

danger_zones.full: the full generated timeline with per-window provenance.

catalyst_playbooks.full: measured reaction statistics per category, with sample size.
catalyst_playbooks.advanced: full, plus cross-asset studies and user-defined event cohorts.

copilot.basic: explains why a signal was surfaced, from the stored factor values.
copilot.full: basic, plus scenario walkthroughs and personalised briefs.

poly_intelligence.research: markets, pair scanner with the full cost waterfall, temporal pairing, research notes.
poly_intelligence.full: research, plus wallet intelligence with provenance labelling.
poly_intelligence.advanced: full, plus Paper Lab on supplied fill history, cohort studies and export.
